result.topic_en: Short calculations with differentials of a cross-ratio-like expression in r, s, r', s', together with Riemann's drafts of lecture announcements (Göttingen, 25 October 1861) for his course on the general theory of integrals of algebraic differentials, and small tables of 0/1 arrays labelled with sums of a, b, c.

items.quote: In diesem Semester gedenke ich die allgemeine Theorie der Integrale algebraischer Differentialien [-ausführlich-] {+vorzutragen+}
items.english: This semester I intend to lecture on the general theory of integrals of algebraic differentials (as a continuation of the lecture on elliptic and Abelian functions).

items.quote: werde ich am Montag den 28 October 10 Uhr im Auditorium № 1. beginnen
items.english: I will begin my lecture on the general theory of integrals of algebraic differentials on Monday 28 October at 10 o'clock in Auditorium No. 1.

items.quote: In diesem {+Semester+} gedenke ich meine Vorlesung über die Functionen einer veränderlichen {+complexen+} Größe, insbesondere die Behandlung der Theorie der Integrale algebraischer Differentialien fortzusetzen
items.english: This semester I intend to continue my lecture on functions of a variable complex quantity, in particular the treatment of the theory of integrals of algebraic differentials.
